title: Junie's Speedy Splash Race
markdown:
The River Race day was here, all bubbly and bright! Little boats, like nutshells and leafy rafts, bobbed and wiggled. Froggies croaked happy tunes, dragonflies zoomed, and shy fish peeked from behind reeds.

Ready, set, splash — but wait for the start!

“Where’s Junie?” called Pip the otter.

“Getting ready to start the race!” hooted Tilly the tortoise. “You know Junie. Everything must be just so!”

Junie the otter sat on a sunny stone. Her fur was smooth, her paws were placed just right, and her spectacles gleamed. She cleared her throat.

“Ahem!” she began in a tiny, tinkling voice. “Welcome, everyone! The river is ready! The boats are waiting! I am here to announce our magnificent race!”

Pip tapped his foot. The little boats, with snails and frogs aboard, started to drift.

“Oh, fiddlesticks,” whispered Tilly. “They’re starting without her!”

Junie blinked. Her long scroll lay unrolled.

“First,” she announced, her voice a bit prim, “the speedy Lilypad Flyer, captained by Bartholomew Beetle!”

Splish! Splosh! The boats drifted further.

“Oh my whiskers!” Junie whispered. She looked at her scroll. “Next, the dazzling Dragonfly Dart, piloted by Penelope Periwinkle…”

Pip nudged the Lilypad Flyer closer. The snails wiggled their antennae.

Junie sighed. She saw the impatient racers and the warm, happy sun. She loved rules, yes, but she loved giggles and cheers even more. Slowly, she rolled up her long scroll.

“Right then!” Junie chirped, her voice suddenly bouncy and bright. “Forget the fancy words! Get ready! On your marks… set… GO!”

Ready, set, splash — and now for the start!

The race was on! Boats zoomed and zipped! Junie watched, her heart bubbling with fizzy joy. It felt so good to just start the race, to see happy splashes and hear excited shouts. Cheers echoed all around. The Lilypad Flyer and the Dragonfly Dart bobbed and raced, and Junie the otter, spectacles gleaming, did not unroll her scroll again.
